item: Sepsis and Septic Shock in the ED (CMJAH)

symptoms: Infection + physiological instability: temp >38°C or <36°C, elevated RR, elevated HR, hypotension, elevated shock index, elevated serum lactate

management_steps.details:
1. Measure Lactate level.
2. Obtain blood cultures prior to antibiotics.
3. Administer broad-spectrum IV antibiotics within 1 hour.
4. Administer 30ml/kg crystalloid fluid bolus for hypotension or Lactate > 4 mmol/L.

1. Start Adrenaline/vasopressors if MAP < 65 mmHg during/after fluids.
2. Re-assess fluid status and tissue perfusion.
3. Remeasure lactate if initial level was elevated.

warnings: Tailor 30ml/kg fluid volume if patient has pre-existing heart failure or fluid overload risks.
